source.title: Saida - Vampiric Vine
source.name: Saida
source.description: A cunning Rogue who values survival above all, she plants Drain Seeds to siphon life and Energy from her enemies.

skills.name: Seed Siphon

description.raw: Active. Saida teleports in front of an enemy, preventing them from moving or acting. She deals 520% (ATK-based) + 60% (SP-based) damage and drains 220 + 20 (SP-based) Energy from the enemy. Saida remains unaffected while doing this and plants a Drain Seed in the enemy. She prioritizes enemies without a Drain Seed. This seed drops to the ground if its host is defeated or if Saida uses her Ultimate on its host again. Up to 8 Drain Seeds can exist on the battlefield at the same time. In boss fights, Drain Seeds on the ground will not obstruct unit movement. Passive. Every 2.5s, Drain Seeds deal 250% (ATK-based) damage to its host and reduces their Energy by 120.

skills.description_lite: Saida teleports to an enemy and plants a Drain Seed in them. The Drain Seed periodically deals damage to the host and reduces their Energy.

skills.name: Crimson Claim

description.raw: Passive. Saida restores extra HP equal to 100% of the damage dealt by her normal attacks and skills. Any excess healing from this effect is converted into a shield. The shield value cannot exceed 3000% (ATK-based) + 300% (SP-based). Active. Saida forms a blood spike to pierce an enemy, dealing 420% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based) damage an interrupting their action. If any Drain Seeds are within 1 tile of the enemy, each one also forms blood spikes to strike that enemy, dealing 30% (ATK-based) damage.

skills.description_lite: Passive. Saida restores HP when she deals damage. Any excess healing from this effect is converted into a shield. Active. Saida deals damage to an enemy, commanding nearby Drain Seeds to damage the same enemy.

skills.name: Revenant Sprout

description.raw: When Saida is defeated, she consumes a Drain Seed to revive at the seed's position, restoring 10% (HP-based) + 1% (SP-based) HP. She prioritizes the oldest seed available and restores an extra 2.5% (HP-based) for each second the consumed seed existed. The extra HP cannot exceed 50% (HP-based).

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Saida reduces her damage taken by 12% during battle. She further reduces her damage taken by an extra 2% for each existing Drain Seed, up to a maximum of 10%.

skills.description_lite: Saida reduces her damage taken during battle. She further reduces her damage taken for each existing Drain Seed.

skills.name: Deepening Roots

description.raw: Saida reduces the damage dealt by enemies afflicted with a Drain Seed by 35%. Each time she casts her Ultimate, the interval between Drain Seed attack effects is shortened by 0.5s, up to a maximum reduction of 1.5s for the current battle.
active: Saida reduces the damage dealt by enemies afflicted with a Drain Seed by 35%.
Each time she casts her Ultimate, the interval between Drain Seed attack effects is shortened by 0.5s, up to a maximum reduction of 1.5s for the current battle.

text: Increases the damage dealt by Drain Seeds to 290% (ATK-based).
Increases the damage dealt by Drain Seeds to 330% (ATK-based).

When Saida has shortened the interval between Drain Seed's attack effects to its limit with Deepening Roots, she deals 1200% (ATK-based) damage to all enemies and traps them with blood spikes, preventing them from moving or acting.
If an enemy becomes unaffected, they are temporarily freed, but the trap resumes once the unaffected effect ends.
Each enemy is always trapped for a total of 45s, losing 160% (ATK-based) HP per second while trapped.

skills.description_lite: Saida shortens the interval between Drain Seed attack effects each time she uses her Ultimate.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: When a battle starts, Saida plants Drain Seeds in 2 nearby allied heroes. These seeds do not harm allies but grant them a shield that can absorb 800% (ATK-based) damage.
